display.title: Viewer display
display.description: Where the agent's sigil viewer draws: mod (a pane inside Claude Code) or multiplex (a herdr / tmux / zellij split running view.py live). auto: multiplex inside a multiplexer, else mod.

layout.title: Viewer layout
layout.description: How the viewer fits a drawing wider than its pane: wrap (fit the width, grow down), pan (keep the natural layout; the pane's h and l keys pan it) or auto (whichever overflows less).
